codeReview.summary: The implementation fully satisfies VAL-INFRA-01. A well-formed playwright.config.ts exists at the repo root with all required configuration elements: defineConfig from @playwright/test, chromium project with headless mode, webServer block for Vite dev server on port 5173 with reuseExistingServer: true and 60s timeout (>=30s requirement), baseURL set to http://localhost:5173, and workers: 1. The @playwright/test@1.58.2 package was installed as a devDependency. Verification confirmed: npx playwright test --list ran without config error, lint passed cleanly, and typecheck failures were pre-existing in unrelated @glade/web test files.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The playwright.config.ts webServer command uses 'BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100 bun run dev:web' which matches the web service in services.yaml. The worker correctly aligned the config with the service definition. This is properly documented.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: playwright.config.ts line 33 and .factory/services.yaml web service start command both use BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100 bun run dev:web

sharedStateObservations.observation: The Vite proxy configuration quirk (BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100 needed for correct /ws and /health proxying) was already documented in environment.md by a subsequent worker. The setup-playwright-config worker correctly set this env var in the webServer command without needing explicit documentation at the time — this was sound engineering practice.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: environment.md section 'Vite Proxy Configuration' documents this quirk; playwright.config.ts webServer.command includes BAYESGROVE_SERVER_PORT=3100

sharedStateObservations.observation: The module resolution limitation (Playwright's Node.js runner cannot resolve bun workspace packages like @glade/shared) was discovered by a subsequent worker (setup-test-fixtures) and documented in environment.md. This did not affect setup-playwright-config since it only creates the config file, not fixtures. No action needed for this feature.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: environment.md section 'E2E Test Infrastructure > Module Resolution' documents this; the placeholder test only imports from @playwright/test
